mechanic: Pulse sonar to reveal moving targets temporarily, then intercept them while noise also attracts threats. Recover beacons from three dark caverns.

mechanic: Move between cooling and heating stations, carry hot components, and repair a freezing engine while temperature changes traversal and handling. Complete three repair sequences.
